crossRefs.note: For they persecute him whom you have wounded. They tell of the sorrow of those whom you have hurt.
I am very angry with the nations that are at ease; for I was but a little displeased, but they added to the calamity.”

translations.web: They mar my path. They promote my destruction without anyone’s help.
translations.bsb: They tear up my path; they profit from my destruction, with no one to restrain them.
translations.kjv: They mar my path, they set forward my calamity, they have no helper.
translations.asv: They mar my path, They set forward my calamity, Even men that have no helper.
